scope: search (FTS5 + indexed), save, rerank (weak CE) at 1K/10K/100K
deep_rerank_out_of_scope: jina-reranker-v3 deep_rerank=True is opt-in; measured separately (8.5s cold + 1.9-16.7s per top-5..50 query on CPU)

measurements.name: save
measurements.notes: direct SQLite INSERT; no frontmatter parse; covers the new memory_embeddings insert via trigger or follow-up

measurements.name: fts5_search
measurements.notes: 20 random terms; LIMIT 20; sqlite3 direct; no rerank, no semantic fallback

measurements.name: indexed_search
measurements.notes: EmbeddingSearch.search() with usearch HNSW + FP32 rerank; includes model2vec encode of the query (warm model); end-to-end including DB I/O + cache load on iter 0

measurements.name: rerank
measurements.notes: weak CE (IDF + bigram phrase bonus) on top_k=20 FTS hits; deep_rerank=False (default); jina-reranker-v3 not measured (opt-in, off the envelope)
